newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - KEMIRA JAN-AUG PROFIT SEEN UP. [CORRECTED 12:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - KEMIRA JAN-AUG PROFIT SEEN UP. [CORRECTED 12:25 GMT]

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 623 million markka median
forecast for chemicals group Kemira Oy's January-August profit
after financial items, before extraordinaries.
Profit after financial items
(FIM million)
Median 623
Mean 621
Lowest 540
Highest 702
The results are due on October 3 early in the morning.
In January-August 1995, Kemira posted a 478 million markka
profit. Kemira said on August 27 the consolidated full-year 1996
operating profit would be roughly on par with last year despite
a weak performance by its pigments unit.
For Kemira's full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 11 analysts
polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items,

before extraordinaries of 920 million (Corrects from 876 million) markka (mean 894 million (Corrects from mean 861 million)) in a 789-956 million markka range (Corrects from 661-956 million markka range). The corresponding 1995 profit was 718 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September and
on September 30.
Contributors to the survey were ABB Aros Securities, AG
Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda,
Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Opstock.
